title: Yeasty Molten French Feta Gratin
description: A romantic French dish featuring cubed feta cheese in a yeasty molten sauce, cooked to perfection using a nimono-simmer method and gluten-free-friendly ingredients. This recipe is perfect for a special occasion or a cozy night in.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together the yeast and warm water, letting it sit for 5 minutes until frothy.
In a large skillet, melt the butter over medium heat and saute the diced onion until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly.
Add the cubed feta cheese and cook until it starts to melt, stirring occasionally.
Add the white wine, chicken broth, and heavy cream, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and let cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the yeast mixture, salt, and black pepper.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 15 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the sauce is molten.
